import java.math.BigInteger;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {

    private static int weight;
    private static int itemMass;
    private static boolean[] used = new boolean[100];

    public boolean isBalanced() {
        long left = itemMass;
        long right = 0;

        while (left != right) {
            long diff = left > right ? left - right : right - left;
            long piece = getMass(diff);
            if (piece == 0) {
                return false;
            }
            if (left > right) {
                right += piece;
            } else {
                left += piece;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    public long getMass(long mass) {
        int logBase = (int) (Math.log(mass) / Math.log(weight));

        BigInteger bi = BigInteger.valueOf(weight);
        bi = bi.pow(logBase + 1);
        bi = bi.subtract(BigInteger.ONE);
        bi = bi.divide(BigInteger.valueOf(weight - 1));
        long sumTotal = bi.longValue();

        long result;
        if (mass > sumTotal && !used[logBase + 1]) {
            result = (int) Math.pow(weight, logBase + 1);
            used[logBase + 1] = true;
        } else if (mass <= sumTotal && !used[logBase]) {
            result = (int) Math.pow(weight, logBase);
            used[logBase] = true;
        } else {
            result = 0;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        Main.weight = sc.nextInt();
        Main.itemMass = sc.nextInt();
        Main wb = new Main();
        System.out.println(wb.isBalanced() ? "YES" : "NO");
    }
